mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id AS id, i.user_id AS userId, i.title AS title, CASE WHEN u.name IS NULL OR u.name = '' THEN '고객' ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(u.name, 1, 1), '**') END AS author, i.status AS status, i.created_at AS createdAt FROM inquiries i LEFT JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.user_id WHERE i.type = 'GENERAL' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

SELECT i.inquiry_id AS id, i.user_id AS userId, i.title AS title, CASE WHEN u.name IS NULL OR u.name = '' THEN '고객' ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(u.name, 1, 1), '**') END AS author, i.status AS status, i.created_at AS createdAt FROM inquiries i LEFT JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.user_id WHERE i.type = #{type} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

SELECT i.inquiry_id AS id, i.user_id AS userId, i.title AS title, i.content AS content, CASE WHEN u.name IS NULL OR u.name = '' THEN '고객' ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING(u.name, 1, 1), '**') END AS author, i.status AS status, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.answer AS answerContent FROM inquiries i LEFT JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.user_id WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{id} AND i.type = 'GENERAL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiries (user_id, type, product_id, title, content, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 'GENERAL', NULL, #{title}, #{content}, '답변대기', now())
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiries SET answer = #{answerContent}, status = '답변완료' WHERE inquiry_id = #{id} AND type = 'GENERAL'
